candidate_counterexample.claim: apply_packet_turn_policy currently proves that the supplied HOLD event was once admitted by the cortex, but does not prove that it is still the current turn-control event. A later ASR_FINAL/END input for the same turn can therefore be accepted and the earlier HOLD event can still be used afterward to mint WAIT or BACKCHANNEL.
minimal_sequence: accept turn-1 packet sequence 0 as ASR_PARTIAL endpoint=HOLD and retain its CortexEventPacket
accept turn-1 packet sequence 1 as ASR_FINAL endpoint=END
after the final endpoint, call apply_packet_turn_policy with the retained sequence-0 HOLD event and PacketTurnPolicy(BACKCHANNEL)
inspect whether a new VOICE_INTENT BACKCHANNEL is emitted after ASR_FINAL/END
candidate_counterexample.why_material: The policy boundary is supposed to condition current turn management. A stale pre-endpoint HOLD observation must not be able to re-open WAIT/BACKCHANNEL behavior after a later accepted final endpoint on the same turn. This is distinct from the separately recorded PFD6 duplicate-source-event replay candidate.
candidate_counterexample.existing_test_gap: Current WP720 tests exercise one HOLD event followed immediately by one policy decision, foreign event identity rejection, final-event direct rejection, barge-in preservation and monotonic ordering. They do not retain a valid earlier HOLD event, advance the same turn to a later accepted final END packet, and then attempt policy application to the stale earlier event.

proposed_discriminator.required_result: After the same turn has accepted a later ASR_FINAL endpoint=END packet, applying policy to any earlier HOLD event must fail closed and must not append a VOICE_INTENT.
proposed_discriminator.preferred_minimal_repair_if_reproduced: Derive currentness from the existing cortex event/input history rather than introducing a new state authority. Before emitting, reject a source HOLD event when a later accepted input event exists for the same turn, especially a later ASR_FINAL/END event. Preserve mandatory barge-in cancellation and the existing VoicePacketCortex event authority.
proposed_discriminator.scope_fence: Repository packet-turn policy only; no acoustic/provider/physical/GWT/J-Space/effect/training/whole-product claim.

next_exact_action: WP720 mutation owner should add the PFD7 stale-HOLD-after-final regression to the existing repository discriminator alongside PFD6. Only executable reproduction may classify PRODUCT_NEGATIVE; if reproduced, repair with an event-history-derived currentness fence, rerun all PFD regressions plus existing VoicePacketCortex tests, then reassess any VPS promotion.
